profile.subtitle: A CONFESSION OF SELF
profile.p1: Photography, for me, is not about recording — it's about seeking. Seeking the subtle tremors of existence that I cannot put into words. I am Zayn, a photographer based in Shenzhen.
profile.p2: My personality carries the typical INFP traits: idealistic, always wandering at the edges of reality. The lens is my bridge to communicate with this world. In those desolate, uninhabited wildernesses, what I feel is not loneliness, but a resonance that transcends time and space.
profile.p3: Every photograph is a slice of my soul. I don't pursue perfect composition — I pursue the moment that makes my heart skip a beat.
profile.exp1Desc: At 5,000 meters on Mount Kailash, I learned to bow to nature. The air there is as thin as a dream, every breath reminding me of the fragility and greatness of life.
profile.exp2Desc: I live in Shenzhen, where the city's fast pace forms a curious contrast with my inner slow rhythm. Here, I've learned to find serenity in the bustle, poetry in concrete and steel.
